name: Fairmont Hotel Macdonald
name_note: Fairmont's history page and the City statement of significance use Macdonald. The ask wrote MacDonald. HistoricPlaces.ca lists MacDonald as an other name. The Alberta Register lists Hotel MacDonald. The OpenStreetMap name tag is Fairmont Hotel MacDonald. The building is not renamed to MacDonald. The building code is B255. No R code is assigned. This is not the 100 Street funicular, not the Grierson Hill Bridge, and not a Low Level deck.
